\begin{minipage}{0.95\linewidth}\footnotesize Correlations are for the models named, with 95\% intervals from the family bootstrap (10{,}000 resamples; seed 20261104), except the leave-one-out row, which gives the range over all single-model deletions. Partial correlations are given the 1850--1900 overturning strength at the same latitude. Panel (b) gives the family-bootstrap median and interval of each term over the models; the medians of the terms do not sum to the median of the total, so each term is shown separately. In panel (d) each row is a median over the 18 family units or pooled over the 25 models, and the medians of the parts are not additive: they do not sum to the median of the total offset of the same product. Panel (c) gives the median over models of the 1993--2014 value minus the reanalysis value, with the family-bootstrap interval. Families: 15 of 21 models (26.5\(^\circ\)N), 15 of 19 models (34.5\(^\circ\)S), 14 of 17 common models; the 25 models of \(\Fovs\) form 18 independent family units.\end{minipage}
